title: 词汇与句式的变化
goal: 能用准确的词替换重复和空泛的表达，并在保留原意与执行者的前提下合并短句。
exam: TOEFL iBT（2026 年 1 月起的新版）· 写作

body.p: 换词和变句式时，原意不能变。替换 good、very 或重复的动词，先确定它具体指什么。合并短句时，保留动作的执行者，以及原因、时间等关系。

body.box:
Original: The instructions are good. They describe every step in order.
Revision: The instructions are clear and sequential.

body.p: clear and sequential 写明了好在哪里。上下文没有提到的优点，不为换词而加进去。

body.box:
Original: I think the instructions help beginners. I think they reduce confusion.
Revision: The instructions help beginners by reducing confusion.

body.p: 删掉重复的 I think，作者的判断仍在。合并后，减少困惑成了帮助新手的方式，两句话连成一个观点。

cards.title: 具体用词
rows: good instructions
步骤容易理解时用 clear。
The instructions are clear enough for beginners.
good equipment
经得住长期使用时用 durable。
The equipment is durable enough for repeated use.
very expensive
强调成本高时用 costly。
Maintaining the old system is costly.
very important
不可缺少时用 essential，一般的重要不用它。
Accurate contact details are essential for sending confirmations.
重复 help
写明怎样帮助，如 simplify、allow、reduce。
The checklist simplifies the inspection.
反复 I think
判断已经明确时直接删去，不换成别的套语。
The proposal would improve access for evening visitors.
重复核心名词
同一个对象可以重复用同一个词，不换成范围不同的词。
The permit is valid for a month. The permit cannot be transferred.

cards.title: 短句的合并
rows: 原因从句
有明确因果才用 because。
The room is too small. We need another venue. → We need another venue because the room is too small.
让步从句
用 although 连接两个相对的特点。
The course is short. It is demanding. → Although the course is short, it is demanding.
定语从句
that 从句紧跟在它修饰的名词后面。
The guide includes a map. The map marks accessible paths. → The guide includes a map that marks accessible paths.
主动分词短语
分词的动作由主句的主语来做。
The trainee reviewed the checklist. She noticed an omission. → Reviewing the checklist, the trainee noticed an omission.
被动分词短语
主句的主语是动作的承受者。
The entrance was blocked by boxes. It could not be used. → Blocked by boxes, the entrance could not be used.
悬垂分词
主句主语不是分词动作的执行者，要改写。
Reviewing the checklist, an omission appeared. → While the trainee reviewed the checklist, she noticed an omission.

cards.title: 名词化
rows: approve → approval
写出谁批准、批准什么。
The board approved the plan. Work began. → The board's approval of the plan allowed work to begin.
reduce → reduction
原文写明了因果，名词化后才写成因果。
Fees fell, so more students joined. → The reduction in fees encouraged more students to join.
participate → participation
保留参与的人，如 Student participation。
Students participated, and this improved the discussion. → Student participation improved the discussion.
写出执行者
只写 approval 会丢掉谁批准的信息，要加上 the dean's。
The dean approved the request. → The dean's approval of the request
不用名词化
动词更清楚时，直接用动词。
We conducted an evaluation of the plan. → We evaluated the plan.

body.box: Original: I think the induction handbook is good. I think it is good because it explains technical terms. New staff read the handbook. They can understand the terms used in safety notices.

body.p: good 好在解释了技术术语。两个 I think 可以删去。末两句的主语都是新员工，阅读这个动作可以写成分词短语。

body.box: Revision: The induction handbook is useful because it explains technical terms. Reading the handbook, new staff can understand the terms used in safety notices.

body.p: useful 保留了评价，because 从句说明有用在哪里。Reading 的执行者是 new staff。写成 Reading the handbook, technical terms become clear 就错了，因为 terms 不会阅读。

body.box:
Which alternative preserves the meaning and the actor?
1. Reading the handbook, new staff can interpret the technical terms in notices.
2. Having interpreted the terms, new staff no longer need the handbook.
3. Reading safety notices, new staff learn how to write a handbook.
4. Explaining technical terms, new staff make the handbook unnecessary.

body.p: 第一项保留 new staff 的阅读动作和理解术语的结果。第二项增加不再需要手册的结论，第三项改变学习内容，第四项把解释术语的行为移给新员工。

groups.text: Draft: The storage cases are good. They resist damage when moved repeatedly between classrooms.

items.stem: Which revision makes good precise without adding a different advantage?
options: The cases are inexpensive enough for every classroom.
The cases are attractive enough for classroom displays.
The cases are durable under repeated handling.
The cases are spacious enough for larger instruments.
items.why: resist damage when moved repeatedly 说的是耐用，即第三项 durable。原文没有提到价格、外观或容量。

groups.text: Draft: I think the trial is useful. I think it reveals flaws before full installation.

items.stem: Which revision removes repetition while preserving the stated benefit?
options: The trial is useful because it exposes problems before full installation.
The trial should follow installation because it reveals completed work.
The installation is useful because it eliminates the need for trials.
The trial is inexpensive because installation requires fewer workers.
items.why: 第一项把 reveals flaws 改写为 exposes problems，删去了两个 I think，没有加入新信息。

groups.text: Draft: The membership fee is very high. Paying it would use most of a student's monthly budget.

items.stem: Which revision conveys the same concern more precisely?
options: The fee is essential because it provides a monthly budget.
The fee is affordable because students budget monthly.
The fee is flexible because students can pay it monthly.
The fee would place a substantial burden on a student's budget.
items.why: use most of ... monthly budget 对应 substantial burden，即第四项。第三项的按月支付原文没有提到。

groups.text: Draft: The coordinator helps the selection process. The coordinator removes duplicate applications before the committee reviews them.

items.stem: Which replacement for helps states the specific contribution?
options: The coordinator expands the selection process by adding duplicate records.
The coordinator simplifies selection by removing repeated applications.
The coordinator postpones selection until duplicate applications are approved.
The coordinator replaces the committee by reviewing every application.
items.why: removes duplicate applications 说明协调员让评选更简单，即第二项。第四项说协调员取代委员会，原文没有。

groups.text: Original: The intern checked the inventory. She found a missing adapter while doing so.

items.stem: Which combination preserves who performed the action?
options: Having found a missing adapter, the intern began checking the inventory.
Before checking the inventory, the intern had already identified a missing adapter.
Checking the inventory, the intern discovered a missing adapter.
After checking the inventory, the intern confirmed that no adapter was missing.
items.why: She found ... while doing so 说明检查和发现都是 intern 做的，而且同时发生，即第三项。

groups.text: Original: The council approved the grant, which allowed the restoration to begin.

items.stem: Which nominalized version preserves the relationship?
options: The council's approval of the restoration depended on the grant becoming available.
The council's approval of the grant enabled the restoration to start.
The start of the restoration enabled the council to approve the grant.
The council's approval of the grant followed the start of the restoration.
items.why: approved the grant 写成 approval of the grant，执行者 the council 和结果 restoration to begin 都保留了，即第二项。

items.stem: The workshop needs a new instructor. Its current instructor is retiring.
items.lead: The workshop needs a new instructor because
items.why: because 引出需要新教师的原因。is retiring 表示退休正在发生。

items.stem: The committee selected a proposal. The proposal addresses accessibility.
items.why: that addresses accessibility 紧跟 proposal，说明方案的特点。that 后面要接谓语，不能接 addressing。

items.stem: The trainee read the diagram and noticed a missing connection while doing so.
items.why: Reading 的执行者是 the trainee；noticed 是主句谓语，不能用 noticing 代替。

items.stem: The supervisor approved the purchase, which allowed the team to replace the damaged chairs.
items.why: approval of the purchase 写出批准了什么，allowed the team to replace 是原句的结果。

groups.text: Draft: I think the volunteer scheduling system is good. I think it is good because it shows vacant shifts and lets volunteers choose among them. It also warns the coordinator when two people select the same place. The system is very important for identifying these clashes before the rota is finalized.

items.stem: Which revision replaces the repeated good with the stated benefit?
options: The system is flexible because every volunteer can change any finalized shift.
The system is economical because it reduces the number of volunteers needed.
The system is attractive because the coordinator designs all its displays.
The system helps volunteers find openings and alerts the coordinator to conflicts.
items.why: shows vacant shifts 和 warns ... when two people select the same place 对应 find openings 和 alerts ... to conflicts，即第四项。

items.stem: Which sentence removes an unnecessary I think while preserving the claim?
options: Volunteer choices prevent the system from identifying vacant shifts.
The system makes open shifts visible so volunteers can select one.
The coordinator should choose all shifts before volunteers can see them.
The system eliminates the need to finalize a volunteer rota.
items.why: shows vacant shifts and lets volunteers choose among them 改写为 makes open shifts visible ... select one，选班的仍是志愿者，即第二项。

groups.text: Draft: The campus print service is good for small clubs because they can order only the number of posters they need. Producing unnecessary copies is very expensive for clubs with limited funds. The service helps clubs by avoiding such extra printing; it does not change the design process or the price of each individual poster.

items.stem: Which phrase most precisely replaces very expensive in this context?
options: Costly for organizations with restricted budgets
Time-consuming for clubs designing their own posters
Unreliable for organizations placing small orders
Essential for clubs choosing poster designs
items.why: very expensive ... limited funds 说的是预算有限时成本高，第一项 Costly ... restricted budgets 意思相同。

items.stem: Which revision states how the service helps without inventing a benefit?
options: The service simplifies design by choosing poster images for clubs.
The service reduces the price charged for each individual poster.
The service limits spending on copies that clubs do not need.
The service requires clubs to print more copies than they requested.
items.why: avoiding such extra printing 对应第三项 limits spending on copies ... do not need。原文写明不改变设计和单价，第二项不对。

items.stem: The committee reviewed the itinerary and found a scheduling conflict while doing so.
items.why: Reviewing 的执行者是 the committee。found 是主句谓语，表示在检查时发现了冲突。

items.stem: The proposal was accepted by the faculty, which allowed the department to launch the course.
items.why: was accepted 写成 acceptance，执行者 faculty 和结果 launch the course 都保留了。

items.stem: The center needs larger lockers. Some current lockers cannot hold instrument cases.
items.lead: The center needs larger lockers because
items.why: because 引出储物柜太小这个原因。cannot hold 是谓语，不能用 holding。

items.stem: The association chose a handbook. The handbook explains insurance terms.
items.why: 定语从句 that explains insurance terms 紧跟 handbook，explains 是从句的谓语。
